verdict.rationale: three.js is an MIT-licensed open-source library. The full source can be cloned from GitHub and installed from npm, so users can host and run the entire core product on their own infrastructure without depending on a vendor service. missing for 10: first-party documentation that explicitly covers self-hosting or vendoring the build files (e.g., serving local copies via import maps instead of a CDN), and independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
